title: Norsine denies a government cover story for the abduction

tellings.quote: He said, "No." And he believed in what he said.

plain: A man named John Norsine is said to have flatly denied that an alien abduction near Newport, Rhode Island, was a cover story invented by the government. Jim Weiner, a witness to the abduction story, tells Michels that Norsine answered simply "No" and that he believed what he said. It matters because it pushes back on the idea that the abduction was staged to hide something else.
